category_title: Reserved students who limit participation to interactions with adults
minimal_context: Amber is participating in a group activity during an out-of-school biology workshop session where they are observing crabs and supposed to ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's observe the crabs together as a group. What questions do you all have about them?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands quietly with the group, not blurting out any ideas.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Feel free to just say your questions out loud for the group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains reserved and does not say anything to the group.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need everyone to participate. Who has a question?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues to stay silent, as she only seems to ask her good questions when she has the direct attention of an adult.)
